name: payguard
description: PayGuard sandbox payment and transaction reliability platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run worker --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.format: npm run format --prefix backend && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
